## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +2.03%) with SPY/TLT ↓ falling confirms equity weakness and HYG/LQD ↓ falling (HYG 1W: -0.29% | 1M: +0.54% / LQD 1W: -0.46% | 1M: -0.14%) signals rising credit stress.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD ↓ falling (HYG 1W: -0.29% | 1M: +0.54% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: -0.46% | 1M: -0.14% BELOW TREND). Stocks vs bonds trend weakening: SPY/TLT ↓ falling (SPY 1W: -1.96% | 1M: +2.03% CORRECTION; TLT 1W: -0.30% | 1M: -0.92% BELOW TREND). Safe-haven demand evident in GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.53%).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tight: UUP showing weakness (UUP 1W: -0.96% | 1M: -1.90% BELOW TREND) and the yield curve level flatish with slight recovery (Yield Curve 1W: +0.34% | 1M: -1.21% → flat RECOVERY). Duration preference muted and TLT BELOW TREND (TLT 1W: -0.30% | 1M: -0.92%).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals mixed but Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +7.69%). Tech lagging: XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -4.02% | 1M: +1.57%) while Healthcare ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +8.32%); style: Value/cyclicals showing relative strength vs Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US equities in CORRECTION: SPY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +2.03%). China showing resilience: FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +3.60%), Europe RECOVERY: VGK CORRECTION (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +3.28%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation elevated: ETHA ABOVE TREND (1W: +23.33% | 1M: +20.87%) and IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.83% | 1M: +10.34%) signal risk-on episodic flows despite broader weakness; IWM in CORRECTION (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +1.32%) shows small-cap caution.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals strong: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.53%) and SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +14.35%)—inflation/flight-to-safety bid. Copper mixed: CPER in CORRECTION (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.25%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy rally intact: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +7.69%) and Brent BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.54% | 1M: +4.03%). Natural gas soft: UNG RECOVERY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: -5.57%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: SPY and HYG/LQD move in a risk-off direction (SPY CORRECTION / HYG & LQD weak). DIVERGENCE: MAJOR DIVERGENCE across core ETFs — SPY, XLK, XLF show CORRECTION (1W negative | 1M positive) — suppress strong directional conviction and treat positions as transitional.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor defensive/commodity hedges and energy/precious metals exposure (GLD 1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.53% ABOVE TREND; XLE 1W: +4.41% | 1M: +7.69% ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to tech momentum (XLK 1W: -4.02% | 1M: +1.57% CORRECTION); bonds neutral with TLT BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +7.69%), XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.16% | 1M: +7.41%). BEARISH: XLK CORRECTION (1W: -4.02% | 1M: +1.57%), XLF CORRECTION (1W: -2.64% | 1M: +1.08%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.53%), SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.02% | 1M: +14.35%). BEARISH: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +0.25%) — watch for further downside if industrial signals weaken.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency threshold) — VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -10.95%). HYG/LQD 0.75 (credit stress signal) — HYG/LQD ↓ falling (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.66%) CORRECTION. XLK/XLF 3.2151 (tech vs financials) CORRECTION (1W: -1.59% | 1M: +0.59%).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive.  
Energy and precious metals showing strength (XLE 1W: +4.41% | 1M: +7.69% ABOVE TREND; GLD 1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.53% ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk is the major divergence across core ETFs — SPY/XLK/XLF in CORRECTION (1W negative | 1M positive) — monitor for a trend resolution before adding directional exposure.
